comment: The configurations a lesson is allowed to need, cheapest first. Every block in every lesson declares one of these ids in its env= attribute, and a block that names an id which is not in this list fails the build. Edit this file rather than a sentence in a document, because this is the copy the tool reads.

environments.name: the stock SDK
environments.what: One SDK, installed the way anybody installs it. No downloads beyond that, no environment variables, nothing built from source.

environments.name: a checked JIT beside the stock runtime
environments.what: The release runtime with a checked clrjit dropped in next to it under a name of its own, selected with DOTNET_JitName. This is what DOTNET_JitDump needs, and it is a download rather than a build.
environments.cost: One file of about thirty megabytes, and roughly twice the JIT time while it is switched on.

environments.name: a runtime built from source
environments.what: A clone of dotnet/runtime at the pinned commit, built. Nothing else reaches the parts of the runtime that are not in a shipped binary at all.
environments.cost: Hours the first time, tens of gigabytes of disk, and a toolchain per platform.
